body:
**Tier:** C / DECISION. Split from #1001 via PR #1022.

After PR #1022 the library writes no credentials into `countries_root()`. One runtime write into the config tree remains, and it is DVC's own: building the `DVCFileSystem` (`local_tools._build_dvcfs`) on a writable tree creates `countries_root()/.dvc/tmp/btime`.

- It is not a credential.
- A read-only tree is tolerated: #1022's `tests/test_gh1001_no_intree_credential_write.py` measured import and a read on a `chmod`-ed tree with no `PermissionError`, and excludes `.dvc/tmp/` from its "tree unchanged" check with a note saying why.
- It still breaks the "`countries_root()` is READ-ONLY at runtime" invariant (#803 / #914 / #831) on any writable install.

**Possible fix (decision needed):** point DVC's site cache / tmp directory at `data_root()` when the filesystem is built, or accept and document the exception.

Note for re-measurement: a `cp -a` copy carries an existing `btime` over, so it does not show the write; start from a tree without `.dvc/tmp/`.

Evidence: first-pass report residual #1001-b; red-team verdict §5.4 (backlog sweep 2026-10-17).

comments.body:
Investigated in `fix/1031-ci-creds` (PR above); no change made. Red-team r1 reproduced every measurement.

- **No supported override.** DVC 3.67.1's `Repo.tmp_dir` is a `cached_property` returning `<local_dvc_dir>/tmp` (`dvc/repo/__init__.py:281-285`), and `config_schema` has no `tmp_dir` key. `_btime` (`:590`) opens `btime` with mode `"x"` and catches only `FileNotFoundError` and `FileExistsError`.
- **Read-only trees.** Each row below used a fresh `git archive` tree, user-config credentials and a cold read:

  | tree | import | first `get_dataframe` | in-tree writes |
  |-|-|-|-|
  | read-only, no `.dvc/tmp` | ok | `PermissionError … .dvc/tmp` | none |
  | read-only, empty `.dvc/tmp` | ok | `PermissionError … .dvc/tmp/btime` | none |
  | read-only, `btime` present | ok | `(19, 4)` | none |
  | writable, no `.dvc/tmp` | ok | `(19, 4)` | `.dvc/tmp`, `.dvc/tmp/btime` |

- **The 0.15.0 wheel ships no `.dvc/tmp/`.** So a read-only install of the wheel cannot read any DVC-tracked file.
- **Correction to this issue's body:** #1022's `test_read_only_countries_root_imports_cleanly` asserts only on import stderr. It does not exercise a read, and import is clean only because `__init__` swallows the `OSError`.

**DECISION for @ligon:**
1. Ship `.dvc/tmp/btime` in the wheel (`pyproject.toml` plus a release step).
2. Override DVC internals; this is fragile, and `Repo._ignore` would need overriding too.
3. Document the exception and make the failure loud at import.

title: DVC writes countries_root()/.dvc/tmp/btime when the DVCFileSystem is built: the last runtime write into the config tree
